name: Creamy Paprika Chicken (Paprikash) with Pasta & Dressed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
¾ tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and medium dice. Season chicken with half the spice mix. (Set aside remaining spice mix for the sauce.)
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince onions and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining spice mix over onion and garlic, stir to coat, and continue to cook until fragrant, 1 minute more.
Add tomatoes and sugar to the pot, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Return chicken to the pot, stir to combine, and simmer until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Add yogurt to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Once the pasta is done, drain in a colander.
Wash spring mix (skip this step if it came pre-washed) and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta, paprika chicken, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
